verdict.reason: The opinion gives exact dates only for EJScreen (Feb 5, 2025) and CEJST (Jan 22, 2025). ETC Explorer is given as a window (Jan 26 to Feb 1, 2025), and the Future Risk Index only as 'February 2025', with a footnote saying Plaintiffs don't know the day. The opinion also relays these dates from declarations and the complaint rather than finding them itself, so it is not a record of exact dates for all four.
